data.title: Provisional approval of Jobcenter benefits (May–October 2027)
data.summary: Jobcenter Beispielsee provisionally approves benefits of €1,087.60 per month for 1 May 2027 to 31 October 2027, because your income from marginal employment is not yet certain. You must submit payslips for February to April 2027 by 14 May 2027.
data.explanation: The Jobcenter grants your basic income support (SGB II) provisionally, as your income from your part-time job is not yet known. Send your payslips for February to April 2027 by 14 May 2027. Without them, the Jobcenter may determine that you had no entitlement for those months. You may also object (Widerspruch) to this decision; the app shows until when. Consider advice from a counselling service if unsure.

items.title: Submit payslips
items.action: Submit your payslips for February to April 2027 to the Jobcenter.
items.consequence: For the affected months it may be determined that there was no entitlement to benefits.
items.quote: Reichen Sie uns bitte bis 14.05.2027 Ihre Lohnabrechnungen für Februar bis April 2027 ein.

items.title: Objection (Widerspruch) window
items.action: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch) against this decision, in writing, electronically or recorded in person at the Jobcenter.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final.
items.quote: Dieser Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, mit dem Widerspruch angefochten werden.
